notes: A212652_formula (A212652_mathlib.lean): for n >= 1, a(n) = least M with n = T(M) - T(k), 0 <= k <= M, equals min over odd h | n of n/h + (h-1)/2 (2n = L(2k+L+1), exactly one factor odd). mem_row141419_iff: n is in row M of A141419 iff M = n/h + (h-1)/2 for an odd h | n. A212652_row209260: n is in row a(n) of A209260 (A141419 rows minus earlier rows) and in no other row. A212652_consecutive: Pol's 2025 reading (least largest part of a partition into consecutive parts). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (b-file agreement, A212652 n <= 10000 and A209260 100 rows, by certificate/check.py only).
